summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Subfase 2B.5 - WhatsApp Notification System. All 48 backend tests passed (100%). System includes: configs CRUD, templates CRUD, test notifications with mock provider, template interpolation, E.164 phone validation, queue management, and SLA integration.

critical.issue: Route conflict: Old email notification routes (notificaciones_routes.py) shadow new WhatsApp notification routes (core/communications/routes.py). Both use same path /api/v2/notificaciones/log but different collections and field names.
critical.details: Old system uses 'notificaciones_log' collection with fields: tipo_evento, estado. New system uses 'notification_log' collection with fields: evento_negocio, estado_envio. Old routes take precedence.

minor.issue: evento field must be a valid EventType enum value - custom events not supported

action_items: CRITICAL: Resolve route conflict between old email notification system and new WhatsApp notification system. Options: (1) Rename new routes to /api/v2/notificaciones-whatsapp/*, (2) Remove old routes if deprecated, (3) Merge both systems into unified notification service
Consider adding DECISION_AUDITORIA and CIERRE_WORKFLOW configs to seeded data (currently only 5 configs seeded, 7 templates exist)
critical_code_review_comments: Route conflict: /api/v2/notificaciones/log endpoint returns data from OLD notificaciones_log collection instead of NEW notification_log collection
WhatsApp provider is MOCKED - MockProvider stores messages in memory only, no real WhatsApp integration
SLA service properly integrated with notification orchestrator for automatic alerts at 80%, 100%, 150% thresholds
Template interpolation uses {{variable}} syntax and handles missing variables gracefully with [variable] placeholder
Phone validation supports E.164 format (+52XXXXXXXXXX), 12-digit (52XXXXXXXXXX), and 10-digit (assumes Mexico +52)
Deduplication service prevents duplicate notifications within configurable time window (default 60 minutes)
All notification configs use modo_envio='mock' - no real messages sent
seed_data_creation: System uses POST /api/v2/notificaciones/inicializar to seed 5 configs, 7 templates, and 1 mock provider
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subfase 2B.5 WhatsApp Notification System tested. Key findings: 1) All CRUD operations for configs and templates work correctly. 2) Test notification endpoint works with mock provider. 3) Template interpolation with {{variable}} syntax works. 4) Phone validation supports E.164 and Mexican formats. 5) CRITICAL: Route conflict exists - /api/v2/notificaciones/log returns OLD email notification data, not new WhatsApp notification data. 6) Stats and queue-status endpoints work but show 0 items since mock provider doesn't persist to notification_log collection. 7) SLA service integration with notifications is properly implemented.

GET /api/v2/notificaciones/config.details: Lists 5 seeded configs with filters for modulo, canal, activo

POST /api/v2/notificaciones/config.details: Creates new config, validates evento enum, rejects duplicates

PUT /api/v2/notificaciones/config/{id}.details: Updates config, returns 404 for non-existent, rejects empty payload

POST /api/v2/notificaciones/templates.details: Creates new template, rejects duplicate codigo

GET /api/v2/notificaciones/log.details: Returns data from OLD notificaciones_log collection due to route conflict

GET /api/v2/notificaciones/stats.details: Returns statistics structure, shows 0 items (mock provider doesn't persist)

GET /api/v2/notificaciones/queue-status.details: Returns queue status with pendientes, enviados, fallidos counts

POST /api/v2/notificaciones/test.details: Sends test notification via mock provider, validates phone format, interpolates template

POST /api/v2/notificaciones/inicializar.details: Idempotent initialization of indexes and seed data

mocked_integrations.WhatsApp Provider: MOCKED - Uses MockProvider that stores messages in memory only. No real WhatsApp API calls.
